notes: GET_SKILL is checked before argument parsing and preserves the cutthroat-specific \n\r terminator.
A skilled caller with no argument receives the exact target prompt before any equipment or RNG branch.
The first target token must resolve through get_char_room_vis or C emits Cut what throat where? without a draw.
A visible self-target reaches the exact That would be bad. refusal before weapon, room, or RNG work.
A valid target without WEAR_WIELD receives the exact weapon gate.
A wielded weapon whose value[3] is not 11 reaches the exact dagger-family gate.
one_argument runs before get_char_room_vis, so trailing words do not alter the selected victim.
The mounted refusal follows weapon validation and emits Dismount first! with C line endings.
The peaceful-room refusal follows the mount gate and precedes low-level protection and RNG.
A non-NPC victim at level 10 or below receives Ancient forces protect without combat or a draw.
AFF_CUTTHROAT blocks a second attempt after the low-level-PC gate.
Either the actor or victim already fighting reaches the close-enough refusal before RNG.
The immortal attacker override sets prob=102, forcing the success arm after the ordinary 1..101 draw.
The later victim-level override sets prob=-1 and wins over the immortal-caster success override.
Success installs duration level*2/APPLY_HITROLL -2/AFF_CUTTHROAT, improves before damage, applies level/2 damage through set 143, and waits two violence pulses.
Failure emits the literal lunge preamble, then calls ordinary hit with the wielded weapon, and waits two violence pulses.
